Crucible.CustomFull:
Team is full ({0} max)
Untick one to pick another
Crucible.ClearRanksHelp:
Forget saved ranks
Hold Ctrl and click
Crucible.NoFamiliars: No familiars known yet. Open the team or bestiary at Lauda so AutoDuty can read them.
Crucible.TableLegend: Shaded: the team this mode takes · Hover a name for stats
Crucible.TableLegendCustom: Ticked: the team you take · Hover a name for stats
Crucible.NotSeen:
Rank not read yet
Read from the bestiary at the next team setup

ModesHelp.Recommended:
Takes your highest rank familiars
Ties go to the best stats
ModesHelp.Leveling:
Takes your lowest rank familiars, least EXP first
The same order picks who fights each battle
ModesHelp.Custom:
Takes the familiars you tick below
Up to 10

LevelingModesHelp.Minus_3: Uses 3 less than the maximum amount
LevelingModesHelp.Carry_Minus_2:
Uses your 3 highest familiars, then fills the rest with your lowest.
Uses 2 less than maximum amount.
LevelingModesHelp.Only_3: Only uses 3 familiars at a time

TogglesHelp.FightPicks:
Picks up to 3 familiars for each battle and commences it
Knocked out familiars are skipped
TogglesHelp.Loot: Takes all loot after a battle
TogglesHelp.Treasure: Takes one treasure: healing first, then defense, then damage
TogglesHelp.Shop:
Spends coins on healing items, then Beast Gear, then one feed
Leaves the shop when done
TogglesHelp.Rest:
Rests with up to 2 familiars under 60% HP
With none picked you get the 90% self heal instead
TogglesHelp.Items:
Uses healing items when your HP is low
In battle: under 40%  ·  On the board: under 60%
TogglesHelp.MenusWithoutRun:
For testing without paths
Talking to Lauda sets up the team, challenges the board and commences
On a board, the menus above run while you walk it yourself

Playlist.DeleteHelp:
Deletes the saved Playlist
Hold ctrl to enable
Playlist.SaveHelp:
Saves the current Playlist with the name written
Hold ctrl to enable
